name: a-Maze-ing
guessed: maze corridors behind the 2-high hedges are hidden; the path is rebuilt as a loop: entrance (col 3) turns west at row 4, runs north up col 1 to the water pool, along the back lane (row 1) and south down col 4
all hedges read as moss blocks (mottled top, hanging-strand sides); they may be leaves in the original
the pool is a water block set into the floor at the end of the left corridor
the lantern hangs on the south face of the back hedge at the lane (height 2); a lantern is the closest match for the small gold hanging object
the back-left hedge is separated from the mass by the left corridor reaching the back edge; the notch at the back right is read as the lane opening at col 5
